_about: Declared tools that are NOT offered to models (collector entityToolLoader) and are not listed/seeded in the auth tool catalog. Group 'mikrotik' (quoxai/quox #1051) is the executor map: mikrotikExecutor.js exports it as UNSUPPORTED_TOOLS; those tools return not_implemented/501. Group 'stubs' (#1062) holds entity tools with no backend; they return an error live. Remove an id when it is implemented and it is offered again automatically. Group 'duplicates' (#1062) holds tools retired in favour of another tool; the reason names it. Ids are entity ids (dots), except hardcoded tools, which use their tool name. Read by services/collector/lib/entityToolLoader.js and services/auth/lib/unavailableTools.js, which take the union of every group.

mikrotik.mikrotik.firewall.unblock_ip: No DELETE path for /ip/firewall/address-list is on the RouterOS proxy allowlist. src/services/routerosClient.js#unblockDevice is itself a stub that never calls the router, so there is nothing real to bridge to yet.
mikrotik.mikrotik.diagnostics.analyze_issue: No RouterOS REST path backs AI-powered issue analysis; it has not been built.
mikrotik.mikrotik.automation.preview: No RouterOS REST path backs configuration-change preview; it has not been built.

stubs.uptime.sla_report: stub, no backend: bastionSshExecutor has no uptime.sla_report handler, the call returns an error.
stubs.uptime.incidents: stub, no backend: bastionSshExecutor has no uptime.incidents handler, the call returns an error.
stubs.uptime.dependencies: stub, no backend: bastionSshExecutor has no uptime.dependencies handler, the call returns an error.

duplicates.keeper_backup_status: #1062 duplicate of backup_status (the same keeperInternalBackupStatus call).
